text:
Marta (Marketing): We're finalizing the webinar launch and three supporting posts. Need a focused SEO pass: keyword targets, structured data for webinar + FAQ, internal anchor map, and redirects for legacy event pages. Lock content by 5pm PT.
Omar (SEO): I'll assign 2 primary + 1 longtail keyword per piece and label SERP intent. Will also propose 3 anchor text variants per internal link.
Bea (Content): Drafts uploaded. Adding 160-char metas and OG images (1200x630). Do we want SpeakerEvent + FAQ schema? Also deciding canonical policy.
Dex (Web): For SSR pages inject JSON-LD into <head>. For client-side pages prerender the snippet. Example redirect to preserve querystring: `return 301 $scheme://$host/webinar/serve-llms?$query_string;`
Dex (Web): Example JSON-LD (Webinar + performer): \"{\"@context\":\"https://schema.org\",\"@type\":\"Event\",\"name\":\"Serving LLMs at Scale\",\"startDate\":\"2026-07-15T17:00:00Z\",\"url\":\"https://redwood.ai/webinar/serve-llms\",\"performer\":{\"@type\":\"Person\",\"name\":\"Eve L\"}}\"
seo-bot: Preflight checklist: unique title tags, unique meta descriptions, single H1 per page, JSON-LD present for event/faq, internal links with descriptive anchors, redirects are 301 with no chains, sitemap updated and pinged.
Marta (Marketing): Owners/deadlines: Bea - final copy + metas + slugs (EOD), Omar - keyword map + anchor text (EOD), Dex - redirects + CDN invalidation + sitemap entries (tomorrow AM), seo-bot - final scan after staging.
Omar (SEO): Sample anchor plan: landing -> /product/inference (\"LLM inference platform\", \"high-throughput inference\", \"reduce inference cost\"), benchmark -> /benchmarks (\"inference benchmark results\", \"latency and cost graphs\", \"model throughput benchmarks\"), recap -> /resources/webinars (\"watch on-demand\", \"webinar recording\", \"webinar recap\"). I'll add these to the sheet along with intent labels.
Bea (Content): I'll mark legacy splash pages in the spreadsheet: duplicates -> 301 to landing; evergreen recap posts -> keep separate canonical. Also adding FAQ pairs for the recap (Q: How does Redwood lower token cost? A: short answer + link to benchmark).
Dex (Web): I'll whitelist slugs before mass-redirect to avoid accidental chains and ensure querystrings/UTM are preserved. Will add sitemap entries with priority 0.8 and schedule CDN invalidation for OG images post-deploy.
seo-bot: Scheduling audit after staging deploy; will report duplicate titles/meta and missing H1s if present.
Marta (Marketing): Thanks all. I'll update the launch card with owners and timeline and ping if any blocker before content freeze.
